cards.title: Temporary cart
items: The storefront route is /checkout?c=:cart_id and middleware redirects to / when c is missing
The temporary cart is created by adding to cart with is_temp: true
The returned cart id becomes c

cards.title: Buy-now quote
items: Guest route POST /checkout/buy-now/quote needs the guest cart session cookie; authenticated route is POST /me/checkout/buy-now/quote
Quote creation sends cart_id and requires a buy-now cart
It returns quote_id, totals, shops[], shipping_anchor_at, and a 30-minute expires_at

cards.title: Order creation
items: Guest order route POST /checkout/buy-now; authenticated route PUT /me/checkout/buy-now
Order creation consumes the buy-now quote before returning a redirect or created order shops
